fee_notes: The Standard Purchase Price is $212,000, comprising a $100,000 initial franchise license fee and a $112,000 Equipment and Products Package. A 2.5% discount ($5,300) applies if paid in cash at signing or if the promissory note is paid within 90 days. For conversion candidates (existing restoration/construction businesses), the equipment package may be reduced to approximately $25,000–$75,000 depending on equipment already owned. Existing franchisees purchasing additional licenses may receive a purchase price reduction of up to $1,250. Additional territory may be purchased at $1,110 per 1,000 population. A $3,000 refundable deposit can reserve a territory for 6 months.
raw_excerpt: The Standard Purchase Price is $212,000. It includes an initial franchise license fee of $100,000 and a standard Equipment and Products Package costing $112,000. The minimum initial franchise fee is $100,000.
